title: richetia latifolia
intro: Richetia latifolia, commonly known as the "Fever Tree", is a plant species that belongs to the family Celastraceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and other health issues. The health benefits of Richetia latifolia include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and combating infections, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
